input.document_text: Warranty Repair Request. Product: A.O. Smith 25L Storage Water Heater (Model HSE-VAS-025). Customer: Nalini Reddy. Address: 12/3 MG Road, Bengaluru. Purchase Date: 2024-07-02. Warranty: 2 years tank, 5 years inner tank lining. Active Warranty End (2-year comprehensive): 2026-07-02. Claim Date: 2026-03-14. Days to Expiry: 110. Problem Reported: Water heater leaking from the bottom pressure relief valve. Technician Assessment: PRV worn and needs replacement. Risk of water damage if not addressed.
